title: Regular coefficient tensor and the finite scalar complex
statement: For every complex P of completed O_E module sheaves, without a good-complex or boundedness hypothesis, and every n>=0, let B=ULift(O_L/pi_L^(n+1)). The regular-coefficient complex filteredCoefficientTensorComplex Y B R rho P B of [lem-sf-filtered-coefficient-tensor-bounds] is isomorphic as a cochain complex of B_Y-modules to integralScalarFiniteComplex(P) of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Consequently, for every i, their homology sheaves agree on vanishing, and finite-model constructibility of the first is equivalent to intrinsic geometric-stalk constructibility of the localized second [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf].

proof.text: The sheafification of the constant regular B-module is the tensor unit B_Y. Apply the tensor-right presentation comparison, the isomorphism of this regular module with the unit, and the right unitor. The resulting natural isomorphism identifies the objectwise coefficient tensors. Naturality makes it commute with every differential. The equality to integralScalarReductionConcrete gives the actual specified finite scalar complex.

Apply homology to the complex isomorphism and compose with DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors. Zero objects are preserved and reflected by this isomorphism. The two constructibility predicates are identified by their existing equivalences with fixed-module constructibility, and intrinsic constructibility is transported across the isomorphism. No support interval or residue hypothesis is involved.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarRegularTensorIso
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    let B := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))
    Nonempty (filteredCoefficientTensorComplex Y B
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
      (integralScalarRho l E L ι Y n) P (ModuleCat.of B B) ≅
        (integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι Y n).obj P)
